from pipeline_allgather import flat_edge_map
import random,time

def run(n,m,np,Dscale=30,seed=0):
 random.seed(seed)
 comp=sorted(random.sample(range(n),np))
 G=nx.DiGraph();G.add_nodes_from(range(n))
 # backbone random tree
 edges=set()
 for v in range(1,n):
  u=random.randrange(v);edges.add((u,v))
 poss=[(u,v) for u in range(n) for v in range(u+1,n) if (u,v) not in edges]
 random.shuffle(poss)
 edges.update(poss[:max(0,m-(n-1))])
 roots={u:random.choice([0,1,2,5,10]) for u in comp}
 if sum(roots.values())==0:roots[comp[0]]=1
 D=sum(roots.values())
 for u,v in edges:
  c=D*Dscale
  G.add_edge(u,v,capacity=c);G.add_edge(v,u,capacity=c)
 return G,comp,roots

for np in [8,16,24,32]:
